title: [ORG]AIOC-TOM filing receipt v0.3
description: The receipt of filing one TOM Release (or a design report) into [ORG]AIOC-SL. Kept beside the manifest, never inside it, so the release's content address does not change. Dates are checked by the validator with format assertion on.

filed_item_id.description: TOMR- for a TOM Release (its release_id); TOMD- + SHA-256 of the body for a design report (a Readiness Report or a Held Report).

filed_on_behalf_of.description: The TOM Design Lead's Cell; its position has accepted the contributor agreement of Source Lifecycle.

write_scope_ref.description: The register event of the write scope signed under connect-external-port.

status_set.description: Set by Source Lifecycle from the approval decision; a design report stays draft.
